messages:
ravi: FYI the p99 widget showed a big step for /v1/complete during the routing tweak. p50 stayed flat. The minute-bucket sample_count for the route slice was 8. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/dash/xyz
alana: Small-n again. Curious if the console is showing merged-percentile or the per-slice pct by default. We recently changed expansion behaviour.
sre-kate: Pulled raw samples for that minute:
```
window: 2026-05-11T07:40Z
endpoint: /v1/complete (slice=blue)
sample_count: 8
latencies_ms: [20,22,23,24,26,28,310,325]
```
telemetry-bot: rollup_meta: {"tdigest_qs":7,"hist_fallback":false,"raw_count":8}
alana: With n=8 the p99 is basically the max. UI smoothing also carried it forward 3 buckets which made the step look larger than it felt.
ux-lin: UX suggestion: add an inline "estimate confidence" chip next to percentiles: Low/Medium/High based on raw_count thresholds. Also show a small provenance label (e.g., "empirical/raw=8" or "sketch/tdigest=qs=7").
ravi: +1. We should also surface the merged aggregate explicitly: show "aggregate p99 (merged)" and "slice peak (v)" so people see both views. The merged value is often less noisy.
sre-kate: Ops ask: gate p99 alerts if the rolling window has raw_count < 25 OR hist_fallback is true for that bucket. That would have avoided the false alarm during the routing change.
telemetry-bot: suggestion: when raw_count < 50, display both tdigest_estimate and empirical_value (if available) with a tooltip explaining difference. Lazy-fetch raw samples only on user expand to keep payloads small.
ux-lin: For copy: show chip text "Low confidence (n=8)" and tooltip: "Percentile estimates are unstable for small sample sizes. Click to view raw samples and distribution." Also offer an option in settings: "Prefer merged aggregates for low-volume slices".
alana: Edge-case: when routing changes weight, very small cohorts appear briefly. We should avoid smoothing that persists older stats into a newly small cohort. Implement rule: if slice_raw_count < 30 and previous_window_count == 0, reset smoothing for 2 windows.
ravi: Good. Also document in rollout playbook: recommend using median SLOs for low-traffic slices or use combined tdigest merges for percentiles.
devex-bot: action created ENG-PLAT-1810 "Percentile confidence chips + alert gating" assigned to alana + telemetry, due 2026-05-18.
sre-kate: I'll change alert rules for the canary and mark the incident as sampling artifact.
telemetry-bot: note: we can compute a cheap exact order-statistic CI for p99 when n<50. That gives a lower/upper bound without a bootstrap; ops might like that.
ux-lin: If we show bounds, render as "p99: 325ms (275000000)" or a tiny shaded band on the sparkline. Keep it subtle.
alana: I'll write a short spec tomorrow with threshold defaults: low <20, medium 20-200, high >200. We'll wire it to both console and API metadata.
ravi: thanks. I'll annotate the rollout note and close the noisy alert.
